title: Direct professional requests and decision support
learner_promise: Use a six-part Professional Request Framework, challenge missing evidence, and produce a decision memo you can defend.

pacing.label: Direct AI with purpose and limits
Improve the request and compare two options
Check evidence and own the decision

outcomes: Build a professional AI request using purpose, audience, context, task, constraints and quality.
Distinguish supplied facts from assumptions and unverified AI suggestions.
Compare two alternatives without inventing demand, delivery capacity or cost.
Challenge one unsupported claim and ask a follow-up that closes a decision gap.
Save a human-authored decision memo with the accountable owner in the same continuing project.

teaching.heading: Turn a vague request into a professional assignment
paragraphs: The six elements give AI a clear direction: purpose, audience, context, task, constraints and quality. Use the need and value measure established in Lessons 1.2–1.3.
A clear request should describe the useful result and its evidence rather than telling AI to select a persuasive winner.
teaching.think_prompt: Which of the six elements was absent in your first request?

teaching.heading: Clarification is an appropriate answer
paragraphs: AI cannot know customer demand, delivery capacity or costs without approved inputs. Ask it to identify the missing evidence rather than invent numbers.
Clearly mark supplied facts, reasonable inferences and unverified suggestions. Authorized source checking stays human.
teaching.think_prompt: What one missing input might reverse your preferred option?

teaching.heading: Compare options fairly
paragraphs: Assess alternatives, evidence, tradeoffs, unknowns and human review. Asking AI to choose a winner without evidence is not responsible decision support.
A guide or simple template may be more appropriate than automation; compare options using the same constraints and relevant quality measure.
teaching.think_prompt: What real-world consequence makes verification important before deployment?

teaching.heading: Record the decision, not more polished text
paragraphs: A decision memo states the alternatives, source-backed evidence, unresolved tradeoffs, person accountable and provisional next action.
Preserve the original request, improved six-element request, one substantive follow-up and one challenged material claim so the decision can be reviewed.
teaching.think_prompt: How can you demonstrate that the follow-up improved the decision rather than merely expanding the response?

worked_case.label: A founder asks AI to choose a service before checking the evidence
worked_case.setup: Fictional founder considers an approved customer information guide (Option A) and an AI response assistant (Option B). Customer demand, delivery capacity and true costs have not been established.

evidence_table.claim: Customers will prefer the AI assistant
evidence_table.evidence: No interviews, observations or authorized preference records were supplied.
evidence_table.action: Withhold the claim and design a neutral evidence check.

evidence_table.claim: Option B will be more profitable
evidence_table.evidence: Implementation, review, maintenance and delivery costs are unknown.
evidence_table.action: Request verified cost and delivery constraints; do not forecast profitability.

evidence_table.evidence: The available notes do not compare guide usefulness against an AI service.
evidence_table.action: Compare a realistic non-AI alternative fairly.

evidence_table.evidence: The exercise does not establish the founder's authority for any client system.
evidence_table.action: Name the accountable approver before any real-world test.

worked_case.revised_example: Option A is an approved reference guide and Option B is an AI response assistant. Both remain provisional. Customer demand, delivery capacity and costs are unknown. A useful next step is to gather authorized evidence and compare review burden before selecting a pilot.
demonstration_steps: Read the vague request and identify missing facts.
Add all six professional request elements before comparing options.
Challenge a customer-preference claim unsupported by the source.
Record alternatives, uncertainty, responsible owner and conditional next action.
worked_case.question: Which missing input would make a confident recommendation unreliable, and what clarifying question should come first?

application.heading: Preserve and improve your original request
application.instruction: Bring forward your previous audience need and AI role. Record your first request and revise it with purpose, audience, context, task, constraints and quality.
application.evidence: Original and improved six-element professional AI requests.

application.heading: Compare two approaches with your chosen AI
application.instruction: Copy the approved prompt to your AI assistant on your own device using sanitized notes. Challenge an unsupported assumption and verify or mark one material claim unresolved.
application.evidence: Alternatives, evidence labels and corrected material claim.

application.heading: Ask a useful follow-up and write a decision memo
application.instruction: Ask a clarifying follow-up, explain what changed, identify the accountable human owner, and save your own provisional rationale in the continuing Project Record.
application.evidence: Specific follow-up and decision memo preserving earlier project evidence.

approved_ai_request: Compare options A and B using this purpose, audience, context, constraints and quality standard. Separate supplied evidence, assumptions and unknowns. Ask necessary questions before recommending. Inputs: [sanitized brief].

verification.heading: Find the missing input
verification.prompt: Name the evidence gap that would invalidate a recommendation and the authorized source that could resolve it.

verification.heading: Challenge an unsupported claim
verification.prompt: Demonstrate one correction or an explicit uncertainty label in the comparison.

verification.heading: Show that the follow-up changed the decision
verification.prompt: Preserve the original request, improved request and follow-up; explain why the final human rationale is more dependable.

completion_criteria: One important AI assumption challenged and one material claim verified or marked unknown
Clarifying follow-up improves a concrete decision gap
Human-owned decision memo saved to same continuing Project Record
handoff: Use this documented professional request, evidence review and decision memo to scope a finishable artifact in Lesson 1.5, without opening the next workbook section early.
